name: hora-calendar
title: hora Calendar
description: The official hora Calendar extension. Create events and tasks in plain language and join your next meeting, without leaving Raycast.
author: szamski

commands.name: create-calendar-event
commands.title: Create Calendar Event
commands.subtitle: hora Calendar
commands.description: Describe an event in plain language and save it straight to your Google Calendar.

arguments.name: sentence
arguments.placeholder: lunch with Kuba on Thursday at 1pm

commands.name: create-meeting
commands.title: Create Meeting
commands.subtitle: hora Calendar
commands.description: Parse a sentence, then open it in hora to add guests, a room or a call before saving.

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: hora Calendar
commands.description: Add a task to one of your Google Tasks lists, with a due date and notes.

commands.name: join-next-meeting
commands.title: Join Next Meeting
commands.subtitle: hora Calendar
commands.description: Find an upcoming meeting and open its link in the right app and the right account.

preferences.name: calendarName
preferences.title: Default Calendar
preferences.description: Calendar that Quick Add Event writes to. Leave empty to use the primary calendar of your first connected account.

preferences.name: closeWindowOnAdd
preferences.label: Close Raycast after adding
preferences.description: Dismiss the Raycast window as soon as a quick add is sent.
